{{Term/Store|Hidden Chest|Hidden Chests|Series, BotW|plural}},<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Nintendo|page= 94}}</ref> also known as '''EX Chests''',<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 377}}</ref> are [[Object]]s in {{BotW}}. They were added in the ''[[Breath of the Wild Expansion Pass]]''.

==Location and Uses==
Hidden Chests are special [[Treasure Chest]]s that are made available by purchasing [[Downloadable Content]]. With paid Downloadable Content installed, Hidden Chests will appear throughout [[Hyrule]]. They resemble [[Metal Chest]]s but with purple bodies and the English letters "EX" on their faces. An identical type of Treasure Chest known as [[Bonus Chest]]s can also be found as rewards for purchasing the ''[[Breath of the Wild Expansion Pass]]''.

There are 21 total Hidden Chests scattered throughout Hyrule, 13 of which are found embedded in the ground, three of which are found underwater, and five of which sit in the open. Hidden Chests all contain unique [[Item]]s such as exclusive [[Armor]]. All such Hidden Chests are subject of one of 12 [[Side Quest]]s—six added in {{TMT}}, and six in {{TCB}}.

Because Hidden Chests are metallic, they can conduct [[Electricity]] and may attract [[Lightning]]. They can be manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] and [[Stasis]] [[Rune]]s. Both the [[Camera]] Rune and the [[Sheikah Sensor +]] functions of the [[Sheikah Slate]] treat Hidden Chests like any other Treasure Chest.
